item.title: Erasure Poetry Workshop — Tue Nov 17, 2:00 PM — Rincon Valley Library
item.description:
You're invited to create erasure poems from various texts such as dictionaries, field guides, novels, or materials of your choosing. Melissa Eleftherion \(she/they\) is a writer, a librarian, and a visual artist. Born & raised in Brooklyn, they are the author of four poetry collections: field guide to autobiography \(The Operating System, 2018\), gutter rainbows \(Querencia Press, 2024\), Suture \(Cooper Dillon, 2026\) & Malocchia \(White Stag, 2026\). Melissa served as Poet Laureate for the City of Ukiah \(2021-2024\), and now lives in Northern California where she manages the Ukiah Branch Library and curates the LOBA Reading Series. Recent work is available at www.apoetlibrarian.wordpress.com.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:

Promo Codes are not applicable at the door.
Codes are not case sensitive, but must be typed as one word.
Loud as Folk has been hosting songwriter showcases in Northern Nevada for 15 years and has since expanded to Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and now a return to Santa Rosa.
loudasfolk.com Facebook.com/loudasfolk instagram.com/loudasfolk
This project began 25 years ago as a newly-made-solo acoustic artist, and the initial recordings made that summer laid the foundation for a lifetime in music to come. Through many incarnations, lineups, and supportive musicians, John Courage has been a constant in the Northern California music community. Not only as a songwriter, but also as a recording and touring support musician, producer, and engineer for many other bands and artists.

item.title: Art Salon | The Future of Culture: the Role and Purpose of Art — Fri Nov 20, 5:00 PM — Laguna Lab
item.description:
In 18th- and 19th-century Paris, salons brought artists, writers and serious minds together to talk about art, ideas and the questions of their day. Many new ideas were first tried out in those rooms, in conversation, long before they reached the wider world.
Our salon borrows from that spirit. Surrounded by the works of the STIMULANT art exhibition, we'll gather to ask what role art and culture can play in a society in crisis, and how we might respond - individually and together - to it.
Join us for an evening of art, mingling, a light dinner, and facilitated dialogue with questions and provocations to stimulate new ways of seeing how we might nourish culture for social change.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat, Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: STIMULANT | Spoken Word Performance | The Oversoul — Fri Nov 20, 7:30 PM — Laguna Lab
item.description:
Please join us to celebrate the closing night of the STIMULANT Art Exhibition, Apocalypse Studio’s major solo show held at Laguna Lab in Sebastopol. Come see the large paintings and digital artworks, and see the Spoken Word performance featuring the centerpiece of the show: the Oversoul — 144 paintings arranged in a mosaic representing one great artwork. The Oversoul has a digital twin, also 144 digital artworks built of “animated paint”, a complex tech stack that turned digital images of each painting into moving pictures, deepening the stories each artwork has to tell.
Source: Sebastopol Calendar
